related_questions.question: How to apply for a Kenya visa from the USA?

text_blocks.snippet: To apply for a Kenya visa from the USA, you need to obtain an Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA) online through the official Kenyan eTA portal. This is the only way to get a visa for Kenya now, replacing the previous eVisa system. You'll need to fill out the application form, pay the required fee, and upload necessary documents.
snippet_highlighted_words: obtain an Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA) online through the official Kenyan eTA portal

list.title: 1. Access the official eTA portal:
list.snippet: Go to the official Kenyan eTA website, www.etakenya.go.ke, and register as a visitor.

list.title: 2. Complete the application:
list.snippet: Fill out the online application form, providing accurate information about your trip and personal details.

list.title: 3. Upload required documents:
list.snippet: This typically includes a scan of your passport's information page, a passport-style photo, and proof of accommodation (like a hotel booking confirmation). If visiting friends or family, you'll need a copy of their Kenyan ID.

list.title: 4. Pay the application fee:
list.snippet: The fee is USD 30 and can be paid online using various methods, including credit and debit cards.

list.title: 5. Submit and wait:
list.snippet: After submitting your application, you'll receive email notifications about the approval of your eTA.

list.title: 6. Print and carry:
list.snippet: Once approved, download and print your eTA and bring it with you to present to immigration officials upon arrival in Kenya.

list.title: Processing time:
list.snippet: Allow at least three working days for processing, but it can sometimes take longer.

list.title: Official website:
list.snippet: Ensure you use the official Kenyan eTA website, www.etakenya.go.ke, to avoid rejection.

list.title: eTA is mandatory:
list.snippet: All travelers, including US citizens, need an eTA to enter Kenya, with some exceptions like holders of Kenyan passports or work permits.

list.title: No visa on arrival:
list.snippet: There is no visa on arrival in Kenya.

list.title: Multiple Entry eTA:
list.snippet: Kenya offers a Multiple Entry eTA valid for five years, allowing multiple entries and exits.

list.snippet: Purpose: The eTA replaces the need for a traditional visa for most travelers, including U.S. citizens.
Timing: It's recommended to apply at least 3 days before travel.
Validity: The eTA is valid for a single entry and allows a stay of up to 90 days, linked to specific travel dates.
Other Fees: You may encounter additional charges if you use a visa service or opt for expedited processing.
